 PLANT DETAILS


Type: Ornamental Grasses — Helianthus annuus


Colour: Deep wine-red, developing a metallic sheen [kingsseeds.com](https://www.kingsseeds.com/74726-sunflower-claret-f1)


Season: Flowering from July to September [kingsseeds.com](https://www.kingsseeds.com/74726-sunflower-claret-f1)


Growth Habit: Tall, multi-stemmed, branching




 GROWING CONDITIONS


Sun: Full sun [kingsseeds.com](https://www.kingsseeds.com/74726-sunflower-claret-f1)


Soil: Well-cultivated, well-drained soil [kingsseeds.com](https://www.kingsseeds.com/74726-sunflower-claret-f1)


Watering: Regular watering, especially during dry periods. Protect young seedlings from slugs and snails [premierseedsdirect.com](https://premierseedsdirect.com/product/sunflower-claret-f1/)


Spacing: 45cm (18") apart [kingsseeds.com](https://www.kingsseeds.com/74726-sunflower-claret-f1)


Height: Up to 2 meters (80cm) [kingsseeds.com](https://www.kingsseeds.com/74726-sunflower-claret-f1)


Spread: Up to 50cm (19.7in) [newlands.ie](https://www.newlands.ie/en-gb/products/sunflower-claret)


Hardiness: Hardy Annual




 CARE INSTRUCTIONS


• Position in full sun, preferably sheltered from strong winds [kingsseeds.com](https://www.kingsseeds.com/74726-sunflower-claret-f1).


• Acclimatise plants gradually to outdoor conditions before planting out after the last frost [kingsseeds.com](https://www.kingsseeds.com/74726-sunflower-claret-f1).


• Provide support if needed to keep tall plants upright [premierseedsdirect.com](https://premierseedsdirect.com/product/sunflower-claret-f1/).


• Keep soil consistently moist, but avoid waterlogging.


• Deadhead spent flowers to encourage more blooms.
